question: Where is aquarium situated within 170 kilometers along the travel path toward Forest Glen Historic Railroad Station, Silver Spring, MD from Cal, Sr.'s Yard, Aberdeen, MD?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cal, Sr.''s Yard%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Aberdeen%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MD%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Forest Glen Historic Railroad Station%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Silver Spring%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MD%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, start_point AS sp, end_point AS ep WHERE p.tourism = 'aquarium' AND sp.geometry IS NOT NULL AND ep.geometry IS NOT NULL -- Filter aquariums within 170 kilometers from the starting point AND ST_Distance(sp.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) <= 170000 -- Ensure the aquarium is "along the travel path" by checking if the sum of distances -- from start to aquarium and aquarium to end is close to the direct distance from start to end. -- A tolerance of 5000 meters (5 km) is used to account for slight deviations from a perfect straight line. AND (ST_Distance(sp.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) + ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, ep.geometry::geography)) <= (ST_Distance(sp.geometry::geography, ep.geometry::geography) + 5000) ORDER BY ST_Distance(sp.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography);
